conclusion: At the sealed secondary-0 specialization, rank(Q_q)=5 and a positive density of F_p-points of the specialized cubic lie off Q_q. Therefore the cubic hypersurface is not contained in Q_q as schemes over the specialization, hence not over K_proj. Membership of a point of X_gen in Q_q is an independent condition from Phi=0.
statement: X_gen is not contained in Q_q (specialization certificate)
